gate_checks.name: All-Atom Sidechain Completeness
gate_checks.unit: % non-Gly residues with heavy sidechains beyond CB
gate_checks.reference_source: Coventry / Baker Lab & OPIG surface modeling requirements
gate_checks.detail: Sidechain completeness is 86.8%; some solvent-facing sidechain atoms are truncated in coordinates, adding uncertainty to local SASA/SAP/SCM.

gate_checks.name: Spatial Aggregation Propensity (Coventry SapScore / Chennamsetty SAP)
gate_checks.reference_source: Chennamsetty et al. PNAS 2009; Cao et al. Nature 2022

gate_checks.name: Surface Positive Charge Clustering (Agrawal 10 A SCM_max & Pair Integral)
gate_checks.reference_source: Agrawal et al. mAbs 2016 (exposed sidechain SASA >= 10 A^2)

gate_checks.name: Surface Negative Charge Clustering (Agrawal 10 A SCM_min & Pair Integral)
gate_checks.reference_source: Agrawal et al. mAbs 2016 (high-concentration viscosity & self-association)

gate_checks.name: Spatial Charge Symmetry (CSS at pH 7.4)
gate_checks.reference_source: SE(3)-invariant CoM dipole & hemispheric charge mixing

gate_checks.name: MolProbity Heavy-Atom Clashscore (overlap >= 0.40 A)
gate_checks.reference_source: Word et al. J. Mol. Biol. 1999 (MolProbity)

recommendations: Build/repack missing sidechain atoms on truncated surface residues before relying on residue-level SAP or SCM.
